business_problem: Tipalti needed a secure way to give internal teams timely, consistent AI-backed business insights without moving data into external inference services or depending on specialist prompt engineers.
solution_summary: Tipalti built an internal AI prompt store on Snowflake so sales and marketing teams can explore enterprise data through reusable, governed LLM workflows. Because its warehouse already runs on Snowflake on AWS, the team kept data in place and layered Cortex AI directly into the platform instead of introducing separate inference infrastructure. Predefined business questions are executed through AI_COMPLETE and TRY_COMPLETE, which return structured results inside SQL workflows and isolate single-row failures. Tipalti also used Snowpark to build a custom parallelization function so multiple prompt executions can run simultaneously and deliver faster answers. Outputs surface in tools such as Salesforce, giving nontechnical users consistent insights without manual prompt engineering or data wrangling. The design reduces overhead today and leaves Tipalti ready for future semantic-model, search, and RAG capabilities on the same governed data foundation.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Hosts Tipalti's governed data warehouse and serves as the platform where AI insight workflows run.

solution_components.name: Cortex AI
solution_components.role: Provides in-platform LLM capabilities for prompt execution and structured insight generation.

solution_components.name: AI_COMPLETE
solution_components.role: Embeds LLM calls directly into SQL workflows so prompts can return structured business answers without extra infrastructure.

solution_components.name: TRY_COMPLETE
solution_components.role: Prevents single prompt failures from breaking whole batch workflows, improving reliability at scale.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs the custom parallelization logic that increases prompt throughput and responsiveness for business users.

data_flow: Internal business and finance data remains in Snowflake on AWS, where predefined prompts call Cortex AI through AI_COMPLETE and TRY_COMPLETE. Snowpark parallelizes execution, and structured answers are surfaced in Salesforce and other daily tools for sales and marketing teams.
business_outcome: Tipalti democratized internal insight generation, shipped more than ten new AI features to over 50 users, enabled more than 600 ad hoc analyses, and avoided building separate external AI infrastructure while supporting a $75 billion payments business.
